title: Edit Decisions
description: Editorial decisions produced by the Edit Agent.

source.description: Source file path or asset-manifest ID. Empty string for non-media cuts (text_card, stat_card, and other title-type Remotion scenes) per remotion-composer/SCENE_TYPES.md — the renderer falls back to its title-type dispatch when source is falsy.

type.description: Remotion cut.type per remotion-composer/SCENE_TYPES.md (e.g. text_card, stat_card, callout, hero_title, terminal_scene). Omit/leave unset for a plain video/image cut.

text.description: Text content for title-type cut.type values (text_card, hero_title, callout, ...) per remotion-composer/SCENE_TYPES.md.

stat.description: cut.type=stat_card only. The headline stat/number/short phrase — Explainer.tsx's StatCard reads cut.stat, not cut.text.

subtitle.description: cut.type=stat_card only (and any future cut sharing StatCard). Secondary line under cut.stat.

fontSize.description: cut.type=text_card only. Overrides TextCard's default font size.

color.description: Text color override, read by TextCard/StatCard when set; falls back to the active theme otherwise.

source_in_seconds.description: Media seek/trim-in offset into the source file (Explainer.tsx OffthreadVideo startFrom). Distinct from in_seconds/out_seconds, which are timeline placement — verified against remotion-composer/src/Explainer.tsx.

steps.description: cut.type=terminal_scene only. Timeline primitives consumed by TerminalScene (remotion-composer/src/components/TerminalScene.tsx) — see .agents/skills/synthetic-screen-recording/SKILL.md.

terminalTitle.description: cut.type=terminal_scene only. Window title bar text.

prompt.description: cut.type=terminal_scene only. Shell prompt glyph, e.g. '$', '>'.

animation.description: Motion applied to still images (e.g. ken-burns-slow-zoom, pan-left, static)

transition_in.description: Transition type entering this cut (e.g. fade, dissolve, cut, wipe)

backgroundColor.description: Backing color used behind this cut by composition runtimes

asset_id.description: Label/identifier for this overlay. For Remotion-rendered overlays, also set 'type' to a value from remotion-composer/SCENE_TYPES.md (overlay.type) — the renderer dispatches on 'type', not 'asset_id'.

type.description: Remotion overlay.type per remotion-composer/SCENE_TYPES.md (section_title, stat_reveal, hero_title, provider_chip). Required for the overlay to actually render via Explainer.

in_seconds.description: Duplicate of start_seconds — remotion-composer/src/Explainer.tsx reads overlay.in_seconds/out_seconds, not start_seconds/end_seconds. Set both; start_seconds/end_seconds satisfy this schema's required fields, in_seconds/out_seconds are what the renderer actually consumes.

position.description: Remotion overlay components (section_title, stat_reveal) take a corner keyword (e.g. 'top-left', 'bottom-right'), not pixel coordinates. An {x,y,...} object is also accepted for non-Remotion/compositing paths.

audio.description: Audio configuration for narration, music, and SFX.

narration.description: src/volume are what remotion-composer/src/Explainer.tsx actually reads (props.audio.narration.src, an AudioLayer) to mux narration into a Remotion render — a SINGLE pre-mixed audio file, not per-segment. 'segments' models per-clip provenance/timing for editorial/planning purposes and for FFmpeg-only compose paths; it is NOT read by Explainer.tsx. When render_runtime=remotion, always set 'src' to a pre-mixed track (e.g. via audio_mixer or ffmpeg concat) covering the full timeline, in addition to 'segments' if you want that provenance recorded.

src.description: Path to the single pre-mixed narration audio file spanning the full timeline. Required for render_runtime=remotion narration playback.

subtitles.description: SRT/ASS-file-oriented subtitle config for the FFmpeg burn_subtitles path (video_compose _compose/_burn_subtitles). NOT read by the Remotion path — remotion-composer/src/Explainer.tsx only reads the root-level 'captions' array (word-level, in-memory) via its CaptionOverlay component. When render_runtime=remotion, set BOTH: 'subtitles' for provenance/export/FFmpeg fallback, and 'captions' for the actual burn-in.

source.description: Path to subtitle file or asset ID

color.description: Primary text color (hex or ASS format)

captions.description: Word-level captions actually burned in by the Remotion path (remotion-composer/src/components/CaptionOverlay.tsx WordCaption[], consumed via Explainer's top-level `captions` prop). Absolute video-time in milliseconds, not scene-relative.

music.description: Legacy top-level music config. Prefer audio.music for new pipelines.

transitions.description: Global transition list. Per-cut transitions in cuts[].transition_in/out are preferred.

renderer_family.description: Locked at proposal stage — creative grammar for this deliverable. Preserved from proposal_packet; edit MUST NOT change without a logged decision.

render_runtime.description: Locked at proposal stage — technical runtime that realizes renderer_family. Edit MUST carry this forward unchanged unless a logged render_runtime_selection decision overrides it.

composition_mode.description: Locked at proposal — HOW the composition is built. Edit MUST carry forward unchanged. 'atelier' routes video_compose to _render_via_atelier (no cut-schema, no stock registry); requires `bespoke` block below.

bespoke.description: Required when composition_mode='atelier'. Contract for the hand-authored, project-local Remotion render. See tools/video/video_compose.py → _render_via_atelier docstring.

entry.description: Path to the project-local Remotion entry .tsx (typically projects/<slug>/index.tsx). If outside remotion-composer/, auto-staged via directory junction/symlink at render time.

composition_id.description: id registered in that entry's Root

art_direction.description: Short commitment to a fresh visual language (or a path to art-direction.md). REQUIRED — enforced by _run_atelier_checks.

props_path.description: Absolute path to a props JSON (Remotion --props)

public_dir.description: Per-project public dir (avoids copying the bloated shared remotion-composer/public/)
